note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; language tags are labels only and imply no jurisdiction.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Fictional delivery letter in Spanish with its English translation: three segment pairs are linked by guides and the available equivalent of the key term is underlined; the reviewer stamps the translation.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: four segment pairs of a different letter; the key term has no confirmed equivalent, so the translation keeps the source term in a dashed box, the pen writes a question mark and the bracket of that pair stays dashed.

clauses: La visita empieza a las diez.
El grupo se reúne junto al hórreo de la finca.
Se ruega llegar con calzado cómodo.
La salida es por la puerta norte.
translations: The group meets beside the farm granary.
The exit is through the north gate.

annotations.text: Source term kept until an equivalent is confirmed

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Long titles, names, segments and annotations to exercise wrapping and bounded shrinking.

params.documentTitle: Carta de coordinación para la entrega y recepción de mercancías en el puerto
params.targetTitle: Coordination letter for the delivery and receipt of goods at the harbour
clauses: El proveedor entrega veinte cajas de material de laboratorio el día 3 por la mañana.
La carga se deja en la lonja del puerto, junto a la báscula municipal de pesaje.
Cada parte guarda una copia firmada de esta carta en su propio archivo de correspondencia.
translations: The supplier delivers twenty boxes of laboratory material on the morning of day 3.
The load is left at the port fish-market hall, next to the municipal weighing scale.
Each party keeps a signed copy of this letter in its own correspondence archive.

annotations.text: Each guide joins a source segment to its equivalent translated segment
The equivalent of the key term is available and underlined by the translator

presets.name: baseline-es
